title: Bybit reality check of v8.6 (descriptive; registered before the Bybit data exists)
what: 1) which v8.6 coins are not tradable on Bybit (removed from the universe, book recomputed); 2) Bybit funding instead of Binance funding in every perp sleeve's P&L; 3) costs = Bybit taker fee 5.5 bp (standard tier, HyroTrader's fee to be confirmed) + half the measured Bybit spread per side, instead of the flat 5 bp (cascade entries keep the maker fee 2 bp); report v8.6 under 1, 1+2, 1+2+3
decision: if v8.6 under 1+2+3 falls below v8.4 + tranching (the fallback) in 2022-26 Sharpe, the wide carry is dropped for HyroTrader; otherwise the realistic numbers replace the backtest numbers in the prop plans
